Intruder

Yankee Station

A night-attack flight game about the Grumman A-6A Intruder, the two men who flew it, and the squadron that took it to war.

Flown in honour of
LTJG William S. McConnell, USN
Bombardier/Navigator, A-6A Intruder
VA-65 · USS Kitty Hawk (CVA-63) · Carrier Air Wing Eleven
1968–1970
Right seat. In Settings you can fly as the bombardier/navigator — the pilot flies, you run the radar, find the target and call the release. It is the job he did.
Headphones recommended · best in landscape
